My body is my brain bag

This is totally the wrong approach to take in my opinion. Your body is all that you are, it's your physical manifestation. Your organs and brain are inextricably linked. Your mental health is innately tied to your physical health.

Aging happens, time gets the better of us all, but using that as an excuse to disrespect your body and mistreat it and then blaming the shame you feel for that on others is not justifiable.

Shame is not something you can do to someone else, you cannot 'body shame' someone, the shame is already there, it's a personal thing.

There are plenty of men and women who have treated their bodies with respect and therefore aged very well, and there are plenty of those who have not treated their bodies with respect and have aged terribly because of that.

Just don't blame others for something you are accountable for. You'll never better yourself if you try to change the way everyone else behaves but put no effort into how you behave.
